Added `benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.md`, `benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.json` and `benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py`. Start was commit `ea37e5a18450766b168a3f52a5dc8ca75035dd90`, tree `355201cf1858b4f11795fe455f3f94ab4bd1b8ca`, clean. Only these three files were added; the old schemas, keys and the preparation index are unchanged.

**Compatibility finding.**
- `run_record.py:validate` (111-202) accepts synthetic records only, and eight fields must stay null (116-123).
- `bind_manifest` (208-212) checks manifest bytes only.
- The old record envelopes have no attempt id, plan hash, settings hash or evidence-metadata fields.
- Empty or malformed response JSON is rejected even when the outcome is `interrupted`. This is an incompatible boundary, and the new documents show it.

**Mapping.** All six `raw_evidence_contract` leaves are covered by 24 contiguous fragments, 1,631 UTF-8 bytes. The checker derives this from the source bytes. Each fragment is classed as existing-synthetic, design-only-linkage or unsupported. The documents also specify a minimal future attempt/evidence sidecar. The correctness and grounding denominators stay separate at 4 each. Fidelity stays unavailable.

**Checker.** `python3 -I benchmark/verify_project_run_binding_0138.py` exits 0 and 49/49 predeclared outcomes match. It covers a positive control, stale or detached bindings, missing or duplicate identities, all 23 raw-evidence kinds removed, fabricated verification labels, interruption and unsupported accounting, and the empty/truncated-response boundary. Real admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and complete pairs are all zero. Trusted substantive verification stays blocked.

**Scope deviation.** The parent continuation ran `python3 policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`, which the issue forbids. It exited 0, with `benchmark_executed` false and `benchmark_ready` false. It earns no verification credit; see `.session/artifacts/scope-deviation-0138.json`.

## What next
Have one independent session review only the three new files against their pinned inputs, with the scope deviation visible. Do not promote anything into the preparation index, set thresholds or open an owner request. Don't repeat source searches, closed reviews, historical builders or the evaluator run. Still missing: model/quota/budgets, real repetition and stopping rules, reader/probe suite, trusted isolation/storage/usage checks, scorer integration and owner method acceptance.
